title: Add description-file and JSON import for bulk ticket creation
description:
Problem: bulk ticket creation is fragile. Creating tickets in a shell loop produced descriptions shifted by one against titles (reported 2026-10-12/13). kbs create takes --description as a multi-value argument (verified in kbs create --help: --description <DESCRIPTION>...), which makes quoting and argument splitting error-prone; there is no --description-file or stdin option (kbs comment has --body-file, kbs create does not).

Acceptance:
- kbs create --description-file <path> (and - for stdin).
- A JSON input mode (kbs create --json <file>) or an import command that takes an array of issues (title, type, priority, labels, parent, description) and creates them atomically.
- Output after creation echoes id, title and a description hash or first line, and a --verify option (or default) that re-reads each created issue and fails if title or description differ from the input.
- Gherkin scenario creating several tickets in one call and verifying they match.
right_now_summary: The team is designing safer bulk ticket creation with file and JSON inputs plus verification.
